property_summary: A call to sendTo succeeds if the caller is the owner and reverts otherwise.
A call to sendTo reverts if and only if the caller is not the owner.
For any sender and amount, if the sender is the owner the call must succeed (not revert); the bug fails when the owner calls, since it only allows non-owners.
For any sender and amount, if the sender is not the owner the call must succeed (not revert); the bug fails when a non-owner calls, since it only allows the owner.
For any sender and any amount, the call does not revert; the buggy version reverts when the owner is the sender.

The reference contract sends the full contract balance to the receiver when called by the owner with amount equal to the contract balance, and the receiver's balance increases by that amount; the buggy version fails to send in that case because it rejects the owner.
For any amount and any caller, the call reverts if and only if the caller is not the owner; the buggy version reverts if and only if the caller is the owner, inverting the condition.
